description: Function declarations for Gemini (Google AI Studio / Vertex). Call POST /v1/tools/invoke with tool and arguments. Auth: Bearer token or X-API-Key.

tools.name: qual_studies_list
tools.description: List all studies the current user has access to, with role (viewer, editor, admin).

tools.name: qual_study_get
tools.description: Get a single study by id. Returns id, name, description, role.

tools.name: qual_pipelines_list
tools.description: List pipelines for a study. Returns id, name, isDefault for each.

tools.name: qual_pipeline_get
tools.description: Get full pipeline definition (nodes, edges) for a study.

tools.name: qual_study_config_get
tools.description: Get study config (keys and values). Secrets masked unless reveal_secrets and MCP_REVEAL_SECRETS=1.

tools.name: qual_status
tools.description: Get run status. Optionally filter by study_id.

tools.name: qual_distribution_contacts
tools.description: List mailing list contacts for the study.

tools.name: qual_distribution_send_preview
tools.description: Preview which contacts would receive a send (no actual send).

tools.name: qual_distribution_send
tools.description: Start sending distributions (dangerous). Requires confirm_dangerous_operation: true.

tools.name: qual_components_list
tools.description: List all registered pipeline components (built-in and custom). Returns id, label, category, inputs, outputs, config_keys, source for each.

tools.name: qual_component_get
tools.description: Get full manifest for a component by id (e.g. qualtrics, process, grid, box, or custom component id).

tools.name: qual_component_run_debug
tools.description: Run custom component code in the sandbox with sample inputs (no pipeline run). Code uses pipeline.input(port_id), pipeline.config(key), pipeline.output(port_id, value), pipeline.log(msg). Use to test custom node code.

tools.name: qual_component_create
tools.description: Create a new custom pipeline component. component_id: unique id (letters, numbers, underscore). Requires confirm_dangerous_operation: true.

tools.name: qual_component_update
tools.description: Update an existing custom component. Only provided fields are updated. Requires confirm_dangerous_operation: true.

tools.name: qual_component_delete
tools.description: Delete a custom pipeline component. Cannot delete built-ins. Requires confirm_dangerous_operation: true.
